title: Historical CSV Work Item Message
description: Message dispatched by the historical-dispatcher function to the historical-worker queue. Each message represents one CSV file to download and process. Internal to ingestion-func — never crosses a service boundary, so it is not part of the contracts/ registry (docs/contracts.md §5).

s3_key.description: Full S3 object key for the CSV file

correlation_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUID correlation ID for distributed tracing. The pattern is carried alongside format so validation is deterministic whether or not jsonschema's optional date-time/uuid format packages are installed (this repo deliberately does not install them — see schemas/README.md).

enqueued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the work item was dispatched

last_modified.description: ISO-8601 S3 LastModified timestamp of the CSV file. Used by the worker to derive year/month (UTC) for the ADLS path raw/pvdaq/site_id={id}/year={y}/month={m}/{file}. Required and non-empty: the dispatcher now skips (and logs) any S3 listing entry that lacks one rather than enqueueing it with a blank default.
